# telnyx_email_suppression (Resource)

A manual block that stops email to a recipient, for the whole account or, with `domain_id` or `from`, for one domain or sender. Telnyx also adds suppressions for bounces, complaints and unsubscribes; read them with `telnyx_email_suppressions`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_email_suppression" "complainer" {
  to        = "someone@example.org"
  domain_id = telnyx_email_domain.mail.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `to` (String) The recipient address to block, in lowercase.

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Blocks only mail from this email domain. Not set blocks mail from the whole account.
- `expires_at` (String) Optional expiration time. An active row stops matching send-time suppression checks as soon as `expires_at <= now()`. A maintenance worker later transitions the row to `status: expired` and appends an `expired` audit event (normally within 15 minutes).
- `from` (String) Blocks only mail from this sender address, in lowercase. Not set blocks mail from any sender.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `group_id` (String) `null` ⇒ global; set ⇒ group-scoped opt-out.
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `reason` (String)
- `record_type` (String) View-only discriminator.
- `scope` (String) Derived server-side from `domain_id`/`from`; never trusted from the caller.
- `source` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_email_suppression.example <id>
```
